BENEFITS
Helps low-income families
permanently reduce heating
and cooling bills by making
their homes more energy
efficient.
Leverages dollars from other
federal, state, local, and
private sources, which enable
local weatherization agencies
to serve more households.
Provides national, state, and
local test-beds for the
development and rollout of
new energy efficiency
technology.
Provides an economic boost
for communities by providing
employment opportunities
and improved energy efficient
housing stock and
neighborhood conditions.

TRAVIS COUNTY
HOME REPAIR &
WEATHERIZATION
This program aims to reduce
heating and cooling costs for low-
income families, especially the
elderly, people with disabilities,
and children, by improving their
homes’ energy efficiency while
ensuring their health and safety.

SERVICES
Repairs to minor structural
damage
Repairs to improve handicap
access
Emergency plumbing and
electrical or mechanical
repairs
Repairs, replacements, or
retrofitting of heating and
cooling units
Home energy efficiency
assistance
WE CAN ALSO...
Reduce your air infiltration
Insulate attics
Install solar screens
Install water-saving devices
Repair and insulate air ducts
Install storm windows

INSULATION
Insulation is one of the most
important building materials in a
home. Without insulation, many of
the other energy-efficient
components won’t perform as
intended.
A well-insulated home uses less
energy for heating in the winter
and cooling in the summer.
